units.source_text: 他和那个人之间，若说没有一点感情，那是假话。

en.t: It would be a lie to say there was not the slightest feeling between him and that person.

units.source_text: 但是只能说，他们之间是不引人注目的关系：

en.t: But one could only say that theirs was an inconspicuous relationship:

units.source_text: 只有当他们互相闹些小别扭的时候，才能感受到对方的存在。

en.t: Only when they had some small friction with each other could they feel the other's presence.

units.source_text: 譬如，他说，结婚的本质概括起来说是被开垦的荒地，

en.t: For example, when he said that, in short, the essence of marriage was reclaimed wasteland,

units.source_text: 那个人就会莫名其妙地发起火来。

en.t: that person would fly into a baffling rage.

units.source_text: 她回敬说，把狭窄的屋子扩扩大倒是真的。

en.t: She would retort that what was really true was making a cramped house larger.

units.source_text: 倒过来说，恐怕一定有倒过来的回答。

en.t: Put the other way around, there was probably bound to be an answer turned the other way as well.

units.source_text: 结婚已经整整两年零四个月了，

en.t: They had been married for a full two years and four months,

units.source_text: 他们之间不厌其烦地重复着拉锯战。

en.t: and between them they tirelessly repeated the same tug of war.
Rather than saying their passion had disappeared,

units.source_text: 倒不如说他们是把热情过于理想化，

en.t: it would be better to say they had idealized passion too much,
and instead had frozen it solid.
